items.title: CrowdStrike CEO: Guardrails alone won't stop uncensored AI cyberattacks
items.summary: CrowdStrike CEO George Kurtz joins Yahoo Finance's Brian Sozzi to discuss how autonomous AI "agent swarms" are accelerating cyberattacks against critical infrastructure and financial systems, requiring real-time AI defenses to counter them. Kurtz also reflects on his investment in the Mercedes Formula 1 team and praises the rapid maturity of young driver Kimi Antonelli.
